SELECT s.usuario_id, s.rol
FROM sesiones s
JOIN usuarios u ON u.id = s.usuario_id
WHERE s.token = $1 AND s.expira_en > NOW() AND s.rol = 'admin' AND u.activo;

parameters.responseBody: {"error": "Indica el mes (AAAA-MM), el tipo (general, doctores o secretarias) y, si filtras, un usuario válido"}

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT ($1::text || '-01')::timestamp + INTERVAL '6 hours' AS desde,
         ($1::text || '-01')::timestamp + INTERVAL '6 hours' + INTERVAL '1 month' AS hasta
),
citas AS (
  SELECT c.id, COALESCE(c.estado, 'sin_estado') AS estado,
         COALESCE(e.nombre, c.especialidad, 'Sin especialidad') AS esp,
         d.correo AS doctor,
         COALESCE(cr.correo, 'Formulario público') AS creador,
         COALESCE(cr.rol, 'publico') AS rol_creador
  FROM solicitudes_citas c
  CROSS JOIN r
  LEFT JOIN especialidades e ON e.id = c.especialidad_id
  LEFT JOIN usuarios d ON d.id = c.doctor_id
  LEFT JOIN usuarios cr ON cr.id = c.creada_por
  WHERE c.horario_asignado >= r.desde AND c.horario_asignado < r.hasta
    AND (
      $3::text = 'general'
      OR ($3::text = 'doctores' AND c.doctor_id IS NOT NULL
          AND ($4::int = 0 OR c.doctor_id = $4::int))
      OR ($3::text = 'secretarias' AND cr.rol = 'secretaria'
          AND ($4::int = 0 OR c.creada_por = $4::int))
    )
),
bit AS (
  SELECT b.fecha, COALESCE(b.accion, 'sin_accion') AS accion, b.cita_id, b.detalle
  FROM bitacora b CROSS JOIN r
  WHERE b.fecha >= r.desde AND b.fecha < r.hasta
    AND ($3::text = 'general' OR b.cita_id IN (SELECT id FROM citas))
),
auditoria AS (
  INSERT INTO bitacora (accion, detalle)
  VALUES ('reporte_generado',
          'Admin ' || $2::text || ' generó el reporte ' || $3::text || ' de ' || $1::text)
  RETURNING 1
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'mes', $1::text,
  'tipo', $3::text,
  'generado_en', now(),
  'parcial', now() < (SELECT hasta FROM r),
  'solicitudes_recibidas', CASE WHEN $3::text = 'general'
      THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM solicitudes_citas s, r
            WHERE s.fecha_solicitud >= r.desde AND s.fecha_solicitud < r.hasta)
      ELSE NULL END,
  'total_citas', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM citas),
  'por_estado', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(estado, n)
      FROM (SELECT estado, COUNT(*) AS n FROM citas GROUP BY estado) t), '{}'::jsonb),
  'por_especialidad', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(esp, n)
      FROM (SELECT esp, COUNT(*) AS n FROM citas GROUP BY esp) t), '{}'::jsonb),
  'por_doctor', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'doctor', doctor, 'total', total,
        'completadas', completadas, 'canceladas', canceladas)
        ORDER BY total DESC, doctor)
      FROM (SELECT doctor, COUNT(*) AS total,
                   COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'completada') AS completadas,
                   COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'cancelada') AS canceladas
            FROM citas WHERE doctor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY doctor) t), '[]'::jsonb),
  'por_creador', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'creador', creador, 'rol', rol_creador, 'total', total, 'canceladas', canceladas)
        ORDER BY total DESC, creador)
      FROM (SELECT creador, rol_creador, COUNT(*) AS total,
                   COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE estado = 'cancelada') AS canceladas
            FROM citas GROUP BY creador, rol_creador) t), '[]'::jsonb),
  'eventos', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(accion, n)
      FROM (SELECT accion, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bit GROUP BY accion) t), '{}'::jsonb),
  'bitacora_total', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bit),
  'bitacora', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'fecha', fecha, 'accion', accion, 'cita_id', cita_id, 'detalle', detalle)
        ORDER BY fecha)
      FROM (SELECT * FROM bit ORDER BY fecha LIMIT 5000) x), '[]'::jsonb)
) AS reporte;
